# Locked requirements for the `a2d-tau2` environment (tau2 env service, reward, harvest, eval).
#
# Exactly the frozen `pip freeze` of the env used by every tau2 run (Python 3.12.14), with no line
# added, removed or changed. Notably:
#   * litellm==1.82.6 -- 1.82.7 and 1.82.8 were compromised releases; never float this pin.
#   * no brotli -- absent from the frozen env. LLM_CALL.get_direct_openai_client pins
#     `Accept-Encoding: gzip` because an old brotli breaks httpx responses.
#   * tau2 itself is not installed: the ToolOrchestra fork in third_party/toolorchestra_tau2
#     is reached through PYTHONPATH set by ask2distill.tau2.spawn. ask2distill is not
#     installed here either.
# env/build_tau2_env.sh installs it with `pip install --no-deps -r`.
